exposure: ultrasound-guided stellate ganglion block (SGB) with ropivacaine
cohort: The study included 98 patients with postpartum depression who received treatment at Ordos Central Hospital between January 2020 and December 2022.
finding: Ultrasound-guided SGB with ropivacaine was more effective than escitalopram in significantly reducing depression symptoms, improving sleep quality, and decreasing stress levels in patients with postpartum depression.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was identified as an independent risk factor for postpartum depression recovery.
